events.title: mpp-specs repository created
events.detail: The single init commit became public on 2026-03-18.

events.title: draft-ryan-httpauth-payment-00 posted
events.detail: Individual Internet-Draft; the evening of 2026-02-15 in US time.

events.title: MPP launched with Tempo mainnet
events.detail: Stripe and Tempo posts (Stripe: stablecoins, plus cards and buy now, pay later methods through SPTs); Visa card spec and SDK; Lightspark Lightning; directory with more than 100 services; draft-ryan -01 posted (02:45 UTC).

events.title: mppx advisories and 0.4.11 fix
events.detail: Repository advisories GHSA-8x4m-qw58-3pcx (critical, fixed in 0.4.8), CVE-2026-34209 and CVE-2026-34210 (fixed in 0.4.11); the GitHub Advisory Database listed them on 2026-03-29 and NVD published the CVEs on 2026-03-31.

events.title: Rust mpp crate advisory GHSA-fxc9-7j2w-vx54
events.detail: Critical, fixed in 0.8.0. Repository advisory 2026-03-26; GitHub Advisory Database 2026-03-29.

events.title: Stripe Sessions recap names Klarna and Affirm among MPP payment methods through SPTs
events.detail: Cards and buy now, pay later methods through SPTs were already in Stripe's 2026-03-18 launch post.

events.title: mppx 0.6.29 adds x402 exact compatibility
events.detail: Blog post on 2026-06-08.

events.title: Tempo quoted on MPP compatibility in Mastercard's AP4M release
events.detail: Tempo's statement; Mastercard makes no MPP claim.

events.title: draft-httpauth-payment-00 posted
events.detail: New name while draft-ryan -01 was still active.

events.title: Tempo session v2 merged into the spec
events.detail: Blog post on 2026-06-17.

events.title: Fee payer draining advisories (CVE-2026-63627, CVE-2026-63628, CVE-2026-63634)
events.detail: Two medium mppx advisories fixed in 0.8.2 and a low pympp advisory fixed in 0.9.1 (repository publication dates).

events.title: Subscription intent with Stripe and Tempo methods merged
TAP and Web Bot Auth attestation merged in mppx
pympp advisory GHSA-5r9p-36vq-j23h
events.detail: Medium: PaymentTransport could pay attacker-controlled challenges after cross-origin redirects; fixed in 0.10.1.

events.title: mppx 0.9.0 dual MPP and x402 wrappers
Rust mpp crate advisory GHSA-8xhq-x7vw-8rcw
events.detail: Medium: a Payment-Receipt could be attached to failed responses, and body-layer failures returned a bare 402; fixed in 0.12.0. Not in the GitHub Advisory Database.

events.title: XRPL charge and session methods merged
draft-httpauth-payment-01 posted
events.detail: A revision, not a rename; expires 2027-03-13.

events.title: Generic session intent pull request closed unmerged
mppx 0.13.5 answers replayed Tempo charge credentials with a final 403
events.detail: SDK behavior, not in the draft: no new challenge, so automatic clients do not pay again; mpp.dev documented it on 2026-10-19.

events.title: Mastercard opens Agent Pay for Machines Early Access on x402, naming no MPP
events.detail: Mastercard's news brief says the product builds on x402 and names no Tempo, Stripe or MPP.

events.title: mppx 0.14.1 released
events.detail: 0.14.0, the same day, added idempotency keys and credits for Tempo session charges and stopped settle() from capturing a voucher above spent (breaking).

events.title: OCC publishes the first primary-regulator final rule under the GENIUS Act
events.detail: FR Doc. 2026-21706 (announced 2026-10-21), effective 2027-01-18, the same day the Act takes effect. It sets requirements for payment stablecoin issuers under OCC jurisdiction and has no provision on AI agents.

events.title: Solana subscription method merged; six external method proposals closed
events.detail: draft-solana-subscription-00 (PR #310, UTC date) makes subscription a three-method intent profile. The same day a Tempo maintainer closed six external method pull requests as networks too small for the official spec.

events.title: mppx 0.16.0 replaces request attestation with per-route identity
events.detail: Breaking: mppx/attestation became mppx/identity, routes take identity verifiers, and TAP and Web Bot Auth moved to mppx/extensions/identity. SDK feature, not in the drafts.

events.title: Tempo's T13 upgrade activates on mainnet
events.detail: Ships the Zones prover and an OUSD fee fallback; required node release tempo/v1.17.0 (2026-10-26); testnet activation 2026-10-29.

events.title: mppx 0.17.4 adds Zone payments to the Tempo charge method
events.detail: A payer can pay from a private Zone balance; recipient, amount, timing and memo stay public. The zone credential is SDK-defined, not in draft-tempo-charge-00.

events.title: mppx 0.18.0 fixes identity statuses and requires an explicit store in production
events.detail: Breaking: a missing identity proof now gets 401 instead of 403. Tempo server methods throw at construction without a store in production or on multi-instance platforms.

events.title: Core -01 edited in place with rules for other authentication
events.detail: PR #404, with no revision bump: verify other authentication before settling, a second meaning for 403, Payment-Authorization moves from MAY to SHOULD. paymentauth.org now differs from the IETF copy of -01. mpp.dev announced mppx's expanded identity verifiers the same day.

events.title: mppx 0.19.0 released
events.detail: Breaking: Web Bot Auth and TAP provers take a key pair or remote signer; adds Tempo ID and World ID verifiers.
